description: A grand traditional residential front entrance photographed at standing eye-level in a centered symmetrical composition at dusk. The house is white painted brick with a fine mortar pattern, the facade punctuated by tall multi-pane windows with matte black steel frames and grey painted louvered shutters. A formal arched doorway with a painted white stone or plaster surround frames the recessed entry — the surround features a classical molded arch profile above a fanlight transom window with a sunburst mullion pattern. The front door is matte black with a grid of small paned glass lights and polished brass hardware. Broad grey stone or marble entry steps lead up to the porch threshold, with smooth stone balustrades or pilasters at the corners. Two large terracotta pots holding lush Boston ferns with cascading dark green fronds flank the entry steps, their warm clay tones warm against the white brick. Trimmed rounded boxwood shrubs anchor the lower corners. In the background to the left, a mature autumn tree with yellow-orange foliage adds seasonal color. The scene is photographed at dusk — the sky is dark blue and evening light is falling. Warm amber-gold light washes from both sides of the arched entry onto the white brick, creating a warm glowing halo that illuminates the entry beautifully against the deepening sky. The palette is white brick, black steel, grey shutters, stone, terracotta, gold autumn leaves, and warm amber. Camera is standing height, centered symmetrical, full facade view, normal lens, level pitch.
